audit.why: Tricky 7/10 fits: 50.16% WR over 7709 games, Sylas wins extended trades and hijacks her R at 6; Syndra's outs are spacing and roams, not duels.
Spikes covered: 3-5 sustain trades, 6 Hijack nightmare, 1st item sustain snowball, late bruiser-assassin scaling. 4 entries present.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says 'Skill' on six rows while content win[] and the packet chart both say Sylas on all seven; the full whys describe Syndra winning stages the content awards to Sylas. Cooldowns field has no digit; two Do's/Don'ts bodies are pasted tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Sylas E (Abscond/Abduct) is 13s at rank 1 vs Syndra E at 15s; his W (Kingslayer) heals on a 12s dropping to 6s cooldown; Hijack is 80/55/30s — he steals R far more often than she has it. Content layer already carries the correct verdicts.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Sylas with matching whys/ratings; win[] untouched because it already reads Sylas. Cooldown numbers written in; bleed bullets rewritten.

edits.before: Q on every last-hit he takes — your level 1 poke is the best in the mage pool. Leave spheres on the ground; they're ammo.
edits.after: His Q hits twice and Petricite Burst charges his autos — short trades are his at 1. Poke only as he steps to last-hit.

edits.before: Q-E already threatens the stun — most mids don't respect it at 2 and pay a Flash for the lesson.
edits.after: QE threatens the stun, but his W heal refunds every short trade he takes — respect the level-2 lunge.

edits.before: Full kit: W-slow into QE stun into Q again is a half-bar rotation. The lane is yours to bully from here.
edits.after: His E dash into chain pull closes on you; if the QE stun misses it, Q-W lifesteal heals the whole trade back.

edits.before: Splinter stacks build toward empowered Q — keep poking; every sphere thrown is scaling AND pressure at once.
edits.after: His W cooldown falls toward 6s with ranks — extended trades heal in his favour; stick to single-Q spacing poke.

edits.before: Luden's spike: QE-stun into full rotation deletes squishies. Force the wave contact trades he cannot refuse.
edits.after: Luden's helps, but his sustain spike is stronger in the duel — shove with Q and roam rather than fistfight him.

edits.before: Late Syndra is a one-button court-martial: flank, QE the carry, R the verdict. Spheres on the ground are sentences waiting.
edits.after: A stacked Sylas out-duels you and Hijack turns your own R on you — group, hold E for his dash, and kill around him.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Scatter the Weak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: Abscond/Abduct runs 13s at rank 1 — the window after his dash whiffs is your whole trade pattern. Hijack is 80/55/30s: he steals your R more often than you have it. Guard your 15s E for his dash, nothing else.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: His E-dash into Abduct pull is the only way he reaches you — a saved QE turns the engage into a stun and a refunded trade.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: With your 15-second E down, his 13-second E-dash is always back first — the chase ends with you chained, pulled, and healed off.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Abscond/Abduct (13s rank 1): punish hard while it is down. Hijack steals a stacked R — never fight at 6 with spheres banked under you.
